lots.what_it_is: Three boxes of art reference and literary books, headed by Jane Kallir, Egon Schiele: The Complete Works, Thames and Hudson expanded edition (1998, ISBN 0500092796) in dust jacket. It is the standard catalogue raisonne and fetches strong prices. Also Folio Society Colour (Finlay) and The Italians, Phaidon Focus Marden and Kiefer, Matisse (QAG), Art in Latin America (Yale), Worcester Master Drawings, Robert Hughes Auerbach, plus Dessaix, Hustvedt, Rushdie and Conrad fiction.

lots.working: Keep: the lowest same-edition SOLD entry is the 1998 expanded edition at US$225 = A$342, and 342 / 1.22 = 280.3, rounded down to $280. The 1990 edition sale (A$190) is an earlier, lesser edition, so it is not treated as the same item. All-in at $280 hammer = $341.60. Flip: likely resale about A$320 on eBay AU or AbeBooks, going by the 2020 sold price and allowing that a Thames and Hudson copy with a clean jacket sells better. Less about 13% fees (A$42) and A$40 outbound postage for a 3.8kg book = A$238. Then 238 / 2.44 = 97.5, rounded down to $95. The rest of the lot has no SOLD support and is ignored.
